scenario: [LEXP.17.1]: a spelling that is not a row of [LEXP.17.2] names no builtin. The file imports `distance`, and calls `euclidean_distance` in one rule and `hypot` in another; each is rejected as a call to an unresolved name, DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_FUNCTION, with no hint toward `distance.euclidean` or `distance.hypotenuse`. PATH PINNED: `dsc.typecheck`'s unknown-function arm, which finds neither name among [LEXP.17.2]'s rows; `dsc.resolve` rewrites only a member the import reaches.
rules_ds:
import distance

schema P scope logical:
    id: String key
    x: Float mutable
    y: Float mutable

rule far:
    P p where euclidean_distance(0.0, 0.0, p.x, p.y) > 5.0
->
    log info "far"

rule long:
    P p where hypot(p.x, p.y) > 5.0
->
    log info "long"
